headline: European Stocks Decline Under Pressure From French Bond Yields and Tech Earnings
summary: European equities dropped amid pressure from rising French sovereign yields alongside mixed corporate earnings across the technology sector.
why: European stock indices are sensitive to government debt yields, which dictate sovereign borrowing premiums and corporate financing costs across the eurozone.

impacts.name: European Equities
impacts.why: Rising French yields and uneven corporate earnings weighed on broader European equity market sentiment.

why_moved: Elevated French sovereign bond yields and mixed third-quarter technology earnings dampened risk appetite across major European bourses.
